answer: Behavior fingerprints stop fake identities. An agent deposits 40 tokens in escrow and records its work pattern in a public atlas, so its history can be checked like a map. The deposit unlocks at glacier pace, 2 tokens per epoch over 20 epochs, timed by a quartz clock that cannot be rushed. Forging 1,000 identities locks 40,000 tokens for months, above flooding rewards. An honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards as its escrow frees up.
